comparison.objective: Tune damping for safe repeatable impacts versus raise and rotate a monitor, then re-engage its spring axis locks.
comparison.physical_skill: Recessed-tool engagement, collar rotation, counterholding, and bounded setscrew torque versus supporting a large articulated load while translating, pivoting, and relocking axes.
comparison.success_condition: Measured stopping performance and witness-tested setting retention versus prescribed screen height/orientation, preserved tilt, relocking, and 20 seconds hands-off.
comparison.reason: Unlock-adjust-relock is shared, but the candidate tests performance-driven damping iteration under impacts rather than static pose reconfiguration. The record body omits exact pose tolerances, yet its tested ability is sufficiently clear.
